description: Search applicants or representatives on record with the EUIPO for trademark/design procedures — "find the EUIPO representative record for a named law firm". Each row carries its role (e.g. APPLICANT_BUSINESS, APPLICANT_INDIVIDUAL, REPRESENTATIVE_EUIPO_PROFESSIONAL) and its source. Privacy: street/city/postal-code address details are withheld for individual persons — only country-level location is kept; business/association entities keep their registered address. Example: euipo_search_persons({ name: "adidas", role: "applicant", country: "DE", _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

_apiKey.description: EUIPO OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" from dev.euipo.europa.eu.

city.description: City to filter by, e.g. "Alicante". Only meaningful for business/association entities (withheld for individuals in the response).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter by, e.g. "DE", "US".

name.description: Name to search for, e.g. "adidas" or a representative's firm/individual name.

role.description: Which EUIPO person register to search: "applicant" (default) or "representative".

name: euipo_search_persons
title: Euipo Search Persons
